round1_review_finding_and_fix: the full-class review (round 1) failed one finding: the card's 'Show up Tuesday, Dec. 1 at 6:30 p.m. ... and arrive by 6:15' carried a date and two invitation verbs in one sentence - 'Show up' and 'arrive' escaped INVITE_VERB, so the gate passed a shape the rule forbids (and on Dec. 2 it would read as a summons to a past event). Fixed two ways per the review: the sentence split into 'The workshop is Tuesday, Dec. 1 at 6:30 p.m. at City Hall, 25 Cottage Road. Arrive by 6:15 to fill the room.' (the same split the page's workshop section already models), and the GATE CLOSED: INVITE_VERB gains 'show up' and 'arrive', so the verb pair can never slip past again - the widened gate trips nothing else on the tree (full suite green after widening).
